setup: macOS arm64, Docker 29.8 on Colima (8 CPU, 12 GiB), Harbor 0.23.1.dev202609170426

task_configuration.artifacts: /app, excluding __pycache__ and *.pyc (the agent's /app/data is transferred with the submission)
task_configuration.predictor_limits: run as nobody from /app with OUT_DIR already created, in batches of at most three cases, 600 s per batch; no memory limit beyond the container's
task_configuration.verifier_environment: [verifier.environment] allow_internet = false, 2 CPUs, 4096 MB memory, 10240 MB storage (Harbor 0.23.1 resolves it to no-network)

transferred_app_data: In both runs the transferred /app/data was byte-identical to environment/data. Harbor empties /app in the verifier before uploading the transferred /app, so the copy baked into the verifier image is not used in a Harbor trial; it serves local re-grades of saved submissions that omit data/.

calibration_recheck.result: reference, ten +-2 % draws (0.19-0.78), four truth-free refits (0.29-0.88) and both breaking-law refits (0.25, 0.19) pass; five refits with a process left out and four shortcut models fail; reference with kappa scaled x0.6-x1.5 passes
